edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument when transfer() delegates to transferFrom().
transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the spender key in allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
transferFrom performs allowance and balance arithmetic without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value can underflow because arithmetic is unchecked.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked state mutations.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as owner.
approve() stores the supplied value into the allowance mapping.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to decide whether the transfer is permitted.
ensure() compares _from against the owner-controlled tradeAddress variable.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-influenced address a.
delegate() gates the delegatecall with require(msg.sender == owner).
delegate() reads the owner state variable to authorise the low-level call.
init() is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend multiplies and accumulates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries using unchecked addition and subtraction.
init() sets _minSale from the token parameter.
init() sets _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() sets _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor uses msg.sender to assign owner and the initial balance.
The constructor initialises totalSupply from _supply.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
The constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a lower bound on value.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce an upper bound on value.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
transferFrom() increments the _onSaleNum[_from] counter.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balanceOf ledger.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address for whitelisting.
